sources.title: Anthropic Economic Index report: Uneven geographic and enterprise AI adoption
sources.usage_note: Linked citation and original paraphrases only; no article text or underlying dataset redistributed. No blanket article reuse license verified.
sources.coverage: Claude.ai and first-party API usage; global platform sample, including August 2025 observations.
sources.limitations: Vendor-specific, selected users; not representative employment data or a Malaysia-specific adoption estimate. Historical release, not latest evidence.

signals.claim: The report distinguishes collaborative from delegated AI use and identifies access to relevant organizational context as a constraint on sophisticated enterprise deployment.

task_interpretations.interpretation: We infer that AI-assisted cleaning needs checks against dataset meaning and validation rules; this source does not measure cleaning automation.
We infer that AI-assisted reporting still needs business context and human review; this source does not measure reporting automation.
